explanation: You must connect this instance to Paperclip to connect to {{providerName}} (you only need to do this once).
registrationCheckFailed: Paperclip couldn’t check Cloud registration. Try again.
finishInWindow: Finish authorization in the opened window.
openNewTab: Open authorization in a new tab
popupBlocked: Open authorization in a new tab to continue.
linkMissing: Paperclip Cloud did not return an enrollment link. Try again.
cloudUnreachable: Paperclip couldn’t reach Paperclip Cloud. Try again.
unavailableBody: This instance is connected to Paperclip, but {{providerName}} sign-in is not currently available. Try again shortly or contact your instance administrator.
connectionLoadFailed: Could not load this connection. Refresh to try again.
connectionUnavailable: This connection is unavailable. Return to Connectors to choose an account.
poolUnavailable: This connection pool plugin is unavailable. Enable it in Plugins.
savedConnectionLoadFailed: Could not load this connection. Your saved access and credentials have not changed.
memoryDisabled: Enable memory connectors in Settings → Experimental to set up this connection.
